title: Load Balancing Strategies & Health Probing
learningObjectives: Compare Layer 4 (TCP/UDP) vs Layer 7 (HTTP) load balancing algorithms
Evaluate Round Robin, Least Connections, and Consistent Hashing distribution
Configure deep vs shallow `/healthz` and `/readyz` probes without cascading outages
keyTradeoffs: Layer 7 path-based routing flexibility vs Layer 4 maximum packet throughput
Sticky sessions (session affinity) vs stateless uniform request distribution
commonPitfalls: Health check endpoints that query the database, causing all pods to be marked dead when the database is slow
Uneven load distribution caused by long-lived persistent HTTP/2 connections on standard round-robin
transferPrompt: How does CDN edge caching reduce load on central application load balancers?
